script: If she rejects you, say this. Most men react with pride or desperation. Be the one she never forgets. Instead of drama, stay calm and say: "I appreciate your honesty." "I respect people who know what they want." "I wish you the best." Then turn around and don't chase her. Don't keep checking her social media either. Let the memory stay with her. You gave her no drama and no pleading. You thank her for her honesty and walk away quietly. That shows real self-worth. You don't look needy, you sound secure, and that security is what stays in her mind. Others get angry or beg for attention. Remember: A man who handles rejection with class never loses his value. He walks away with his self-respect. Want to master presence, mystery, and confidence in your conversations? Comment the word CLASS, and I'll send you my free playbook.
